name: Fuchida Mitsuo

names.name: Mitsuo Fuchida
names.period: given-name-first order, as English-language catalogues index him

roles.title: Commander, air group, First Air Fleet; strike leader at Pearl Harbor

summary: Led the air attack on Pearl Harbor and sent the signal *tora tora tora* to say surprise had been achieved. Appendicitis kept him out of the cockpit at Midway and he watched the four carriers burn from *Akagi*'s deck. After the war he became the principal English-language witness to the Japanese side of both battles — and one of the least reliable: the packed flight decks, the five fateful minutes, his own account of being about to launch when the dive bombers arrived, are all contradicted by the Japanese operational records, and *Shattered Sword* traced how completely his version had been absorbed into the Western literature. He became a Christian evangelist in 1950 and toured the United States preaching.
